content.title: Web Accessibility Policy
content.content:
TOTO Hong Kong is aiming to be accessible to the widest possible audience,
regardless of technology or ability.

Target Level

TOTO Hong Kong aims to meet the Web Content Accessibility guideline (WCAG) 2.2, Level AA, published by the World Wide Web Consortium (W3C).




Scope

hk.toto.com
However, the website is not covered if there is code provided by a third party that we cannot manage or control, or if it is difficult to handle with the current level of technology.




Inquiries

Please click here for inquiries regarding the web accessibility of this site.
